mentions.name: Grog
mentions.description: A simpler, "grug-brained" alternative to the Bazel build tool, aimed at medium-sized teams for whom Bazel is overkill. It powers the author's internal mono-repo CI.
mentions.problem: Bazel has a very steep learning curve and is pretty much overkill for most medium-sized teams.
mentions.audience: Medium-sized teams that find Bazel overkill
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Grog, the “grug-brained” alternative to Bazel. Bazel has a very steep learning curve and is pretty much overkill for most medium-sized teams. Grog already powers all of our internal mono-repo CI and is a lot more fun to work with.

evidence.value: I am working on Grog, the “grug-brained” alternative to Bazel. Bazel has a very steep learning curve and is pretty much overkill for most medium-sized teams. Grog already powers all of our internal mono-repo CI and is a lot more fun to work with.

mentions.name: Grog
mentions.description: This is a mono-repo build tool that serves as a simple alternative to Bazel. Users provide their build commands and interdependencies, and the tool runs everything in parallel with aggressive caching.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Grog, the “grug-brained” alternative to Bazel. A mono-repo build tool where all you do is provide your build commands and interdependencies and the Grog will run everything in parallel with aggressive caching.

evidence.value: I am working on Grog, the “grug-brained” alternative to Bazel. A mono-repo build tool where all you do is provide your build commands and interdependencies and the Grog will run everything in parallel with aggressive caching.
